summary: In the hall, Agent Brown kneels beside the body and checks his vital signs, then reports, "He's gone." Standing over him, Agent Smith smiles and says, "Good-bye, Mr. Anderson." The death is confirmed and Smith marks the end of Anderson.

what_changes.before: Checking the body's vital signs to determine whether he is alive
what_changes.evidence: Kneeling beside him, Agent Brown checks his vital signs.

what_changes.before: Standing over the body after having shot him
what_changes.after: Smiling and bidding farewell, treating the death as a completed victory
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith smiles, standing over him.

event_hint.one_line: Smith confirms Anderson is dead and bids him good-bye.
